snippet.title: Into the Evernight Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Into the Evernight is a retro-styled, tactical role-playing game with a heavy emphasis on player choice and branching story paths.  I started building it 20 years ago and after working on it at an absolutely glacial pace, I'm finally releasing it this summer (2025)!

https://intotheevernight.com/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581370/Into_the_Evernight/
